title: Australian Noodle Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and savory stir fry dish made with australian ingredients, perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: Unique noodles
ingredients.notes: preferably rice noodles or egg noodles

ingredients.name: Savory vegetable oil
ingredients.notes: such as canola or peanut oil

ingredients.name: Australian beef strips
ingredients.notes: or substitute with tofu for a vegetarian option

ingredients.name: Soy sauce
ingredients.notes: or tamari for a gluten-free option

ingredients.name: Honey
ingredients.notes: or maple syrup for a different flavor

instructions: Heat the savory vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the australian beef strips and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside.
Add the narutomaki to the skillet and cook until lightly browned, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, honey, ginger, and garlic to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the beef to the skillet and stir to combine with the sauce.
Add the noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the beef and sauce.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the noodles are heated through.
Stir in the chopped green onions.
